# What is on the package server

This page is for administrators and hosts who want to know exactly what an installation can download. It lists the
folders of the package server, the release folders and every package of the 6.0.15 folder. The figures come from the
server's repository (`git ls-tree` of its `master` branch, checked on 2026-10-18) and from the live
[6.0.15 index](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/index.xml).

## The top level

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `exponential/6.0/` | one folder per Exponential 6.0 release |
| `README.md` | a short description of the server, with links to the project, documentation and community |
| `CNAME` | the host name GitHub Pages serves the site under, `exponential.packages.exponential.earth` |
| `crossdomain.xml` | a cross-domain policy file allowing access from any domain |
| `.github/` | `FUNDING.yml` and the Pages workflow (not served as pages; see [The package server on GitHub](the-package-server-on-github.md)) |

The folders of the 3.x to 5.x releases are no longer here; they moved to a separate repository in 2025
([History of the package server](history-of-the-package-server.md#2025-storage-limits-and-the-exponential-name)).

## The release folders

| Folder | Packages | Site packages | Size | Last changed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `6.0.0` to `6.0.3` | 26 each | 9 | 21.4 MiB each | 2025-08-13 |
| `6.0.4` to `6.0.9` | 38 each | 9 | 26.4 MiB each | 2025-08-13 |
| `6.0.10` | 38 | 9 | 26.4 MiB | 2025-08-16 |
| `6.0.14` | 38 | 9 | 26.3 MiB | 2026-06-05 |
| `6.0.15` | 44 | 12 | 86.8 MiB | 2026-10-16 |

The nine site packages of 6.0.0 to 6.0.14 are `sevenx_site`, `sevenx_site_clean`, `ezflow_site`,
`ezflow_site_clean`, `ezwebin_site`, `ezwebin_site_clean`, `ezdemo_site`, `ezdemo_site_clean` and `plain_site`.
6.0.15 adds `sevenx_multisite`, `sevenx_multisite_clean` and `cjw_multisite`. There are no folders for 6.0.11 to
6.0.13. Sizes include the thumbnails.

> **Note**
> An installation reads only the folder its `RemotePackagesIndexURL` names. A 6.0.15 installation never sees the
> packages of 6.0.10, and the other way round ([Package server settings](package-server-settings.md)).

## Inside a release folder

```text
exponential/6.0/6.0.15/
  index.xml                   the list of the packages of this release
  <name>.ezpkg                one archive per package (44 in 6.0.15)
  thumbnails/<name>.png       the picture the setup wizard shows next to a site package
```

The `.ezpkg` files are gzip compressed tar archives with a `package.xml` at the top
([The .ezpkg file](../basics/the-ezpkg-file.md)). `index.xml` is described in
[The index.xml format](the-index-xml-format.md).

## The site packages of 6.0.15

These are the twelve entries with `type="site"`, in the order of the index, with the summary the setup wizard shows:

| Site package | Summary in the index | Version in the index | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sevenx_multisite` | 7x MultiSite Default Installation | 1.0.0-0 | 89.2 KiB |
| `sevenx_multisite_clean` | 7x MultiSite Default Installation (without demo content) | 1.0.0-0 | 89.1 KiB |
| `cjw_multisite` | CJW Multisite | 6.0.15-0 | 95.3 KiB |
| `sevenx_site` | 7x Simple Website Interface | 1.0.0-0 | 77.4 KiB |
| `sevenx_site_clean` | 7x Simple Website Interface (without demo content) | 1.0.0-0 | 67.5 KiB |
| `ezflow_site` | eZ Flow | 5.1-0 | 45.2 KiB |
| `ezflow_site_clean` | eZ Flow (without demo content) | 5.1-0 | 31.5 KiB |
| `ezwebin_site` | Website Interface | 1.10-0 | 51.1 KiB |
| `ezwebin_site_clean` | Website Interface (without demo content) | 1.10-0 | 40.2 KiB |
| `ezdemo_site` | Exponential Demo Site | 6.0.0 | 31.3 KiB |
| `ezdemo_site_clean` | Exponential Demo Site (without demo content) | 6.0.0 | 26.1 KiB |
| `plain_site` | Plain site | 1.1-2 | 28.7 KiB |

A site package is small: it carries settings, install scripts and a thumbnail. The content and the classes are in
the packages it requires, which the installer downloads next. What each site package installs is explained in
[sevenx_multisite](../sevenx-multisite/README.md) and [cjw_multisite](../cjw-multisite/README.md).

By type: 12 `site`, 13 `contentobject`, 4 `contentclass`, 7 `sitestyle` and 8 `extension` packages. The largest
file by far is `sevenx_multisite_democontent` (62,669,990 bytes), the demo content of the default site package with
its images; installing `sevenx_multisite_clean` downloads its `_clean` counterpart of 216 KiB instead.

## The thumbnails

`thumbnails/` holds 13 PNG files: one for each of the twelve site packages, and `sevenx_site_paypal.png`, which no
entry of the index uses. `sevenx_multisite.png` and `sevenx_multisite_clean.png` are the same image. The index points
at them with `thumbnail_url`; the setup wizard shows them next to each site package that is not imported yet.

## Two version numbers

The `version` attribute in `index.xml` is not the version in the package's own `package.xml`. For example the index
lists `sevenx_multisite` as `1.0.0-0`, while its `package.xml` says `<version><number>6.0</number><release>15-stable</release></version>`.
The setup wizard compares the index version with an imported copy to decide which entry to show; the kickstarter
always prefers the index entry for this reason ([The kickstarter CLI](../../../bc/6.0/kickstartercli.md#why-does-the-remote-package-index-use-a-different-version)). See
[Version numbers](../requirements/version-numbers.md).
